description: Ministry of Power and Energy - Revise the Fuel Price to be Effective from 12.00 Midnight on June 30th 2024
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order issued under Section 66 of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961, revising fuel prices. While it mentions the Minister's name and title, the primary content is regulatory in nature - establishing new pricing regulations for petroleum products. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves the exercise of statutory powers to create binding regulations rather than focusing on government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
